tp4-ar.qualification: Not qualified: the M1 bring-up profile, autoregressive at TP4 on the deepseek-ai checkpoint with the native KV layout, which kv_cache_dtype auto serves. The BF16 KV layout is not a served profile: it is qual.json's kv-bf16 comparison configuration, not qualified for capacity, preemption under pressure or offload. Its evidence is the release preview's full suite at the release revision (models/deepseek41/README.md#qualification). Prefill runs exact upper-layer dependency intervals at guaranteed 8192-token chunk ends, prompt ends and scheduler-selected shared-prefix anchors aligned to 64 tokens, bitwise equal to the full schedule.

tp4-dspark.qualification: Qualified through 32 sequences, the default: DSpark at TP4 on the deepseek-ai checkpoint with native KV. The release preview's full suite passed at d3d580aa02 on 2026-11-05 (71 rows passed, 6 informational, KV offload not applicable): the AR and speculative arms, exact greedy equality, the declared speculative-verification bounds at 2 to 32 verify rows and GSM8K 196 of 200 in each arm. Its soak judges host memory as VmRSS less the Rss of the Engram tables' read-only checkpoint mappings, against 512 MiB (models/deepseek41/README.md#qualification). Confidence-allocated batches compute all five drafter heads and score only computed target rows through mapped sampling. Only unallocated uniform depth-three batches of 3-8 items compute three heads. On 2026-10-28, compact allocation resolved a 1.91% request-throughput gain for coding at four streams and 256 outputs, with no resolved regression across coding/chat at four/eight streams and 256 outputs or four streams and 1024 outputs; all used TP4 native KV and temperature 1.0. The adopted fixed-batch GPU smoke on 2026-10-28 passed at 12, 32 and 65 computed rows with greedy and fixed-seed equality of logits, proposals, per-request acceptance and committed state. GPU exactness evidence ends at the tested width of 65; widths 66-192 have CPU coverage only. Widths above 64 rows remain unqualified for timing. Prefill runs exact upper-layer dependency intervals at guaranteed 8192-token chunk ends, prompt ends and scheduler-selected shared-prefix anchors aligned to 64 tokens, bitwise equal to the full schedule. DSpark prefill batches commit projections and overlaps per-layer Engram gathers by default. Prepared gathers also overlap TP4 native-KV single-item DMA prefill at 512-8192 rows; unsupported row services, media and taps retain synchronous gathers. Prefill runs the tbt budget at a 750 ms decode cadence target with adaptive timing cuts; on 2026-10-30 the adaptive cap resolved gains against off in collapse share and gaps over 1 s in the C16 prefill-saturated and burst cells, kept the C8 long-append cost within the accepted tolerance, and matched off's output tokens, answers and logprobs bit for bit (docs/developer-preview.md#prefill-policy).
